tools.name: list_competitions
tools.description: Lists the football competitions Docteur Bet models (major European leagues, three second tiers (Championship, Serie B, La Liga 2), other European leagues, Champions League, Europa League) and what is published for each: match probabilities, full match markets, season projection (title/relegation chances), team strengths. Call this when unsure whether a competition is covered.

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".

tools.name: find_match
tools.description: Finds upcoming or recent football matches (next 21 days) by team name, accepting nicknames such as "PSG", "Man City", "Barça" or "Bayern Munich". Optionally narrow with the opponent and a date. Returns candidate matches with their match_id, to pass to get_match_probabilities. If several teams match (e.g. "Paris" = Paris FC or Paris Saint-Germain), all are returned: ask the user which one they mean.

team.description: A team name or nickname, e.g. "PSG", "Arsenal", "Inter".

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".

tools.name: get_match_probabilities
tools.description: Returns the probabilities for one football match from the free Dixon-Coles model offered by Docteur Bet (not the Docteur Bet model, which is reserved for value bets in the app): home win / draw / away win, over/under 1.5, 2.5 and 3.5 goals, both teams to score, expected goals, most likely exact scores and team strengths. Get the match_id from find_match or get_upcoming_matches. Always cite the source, the model and the calculation date.

match_id.description: The match_id returned by find_match or get_upcoming_matches.

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".

tools.name: get_upcoming_matches
tools.description: Lists the upcoming matches of one competition over the next days, each with home/draw/away probabilities from the free Dixon-Coles model offered by Docteur Bet, when published. The competition can be given by name ("Premier League", "Ligue 1", "Champions League"), common abbreviation ("EPL", "UCL") or id from list_competitions.

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".

tools.name: get_season_projection
tools.description: Returns the current table of a league with a season projection from tens of thousands of seasons simulated with the free Dixon-Coles model offered by Docteur Bet: each team's chances of winning the title, finishing in Champions League and European places, being relegated, and its projected final points. Not available for cups or for leagues whose format the simulator does not handle (see list_competitions).

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".

tools.name: get_team_strengths
tools.description: Returns the power ranking of a competition from the free Dixon-Coles model offered by Docteur Bet: each team's attack and defence strength relative to the league average (1 = average; a lower defence figure is better), an overall index (attack / defence), and the gap between its strength rank and its actual league position.

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Returns Docteur Bet's public track record: every value bet published before kick-off and then settled, wins and losses, with the number of bets, average odds and yield for each country's bookmaker market. These value bets come from the Docteur Bet model, Docteur Bet's own model for app subscribers (not the free Dixon-Coles model); the individual bets are subscriber-only and are not returned.

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".
